title: This Is Why Your IV Percentile Trades Keep Losing Money
text: Your expression is literally in a different volatility than what you analyzed. And it's a super common mistake. Let's say that you're using implied volatility percentile, and you come to the conclusion that implied volatility is moderately rich. You think that risk premium is moderately rich. So you choose to sell, let's say, a 60 DTE short put. The problem with that is you're trading 60-day vol. But the vol that you measured against IVP in here is against 30-day vol for the underlying.
